selectionNote: Selected 10 guided Cusco d937 products with live public USD From prices, combined ratings, unique 674x446 named heroes, and verified itinerary POIs. The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, including preferred bike, jeep, horseback, photography, Palcoyo, and additional ATV or private Sacred Valley SKUs, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (AUD/EUR/GBP/CHF/ZAR/NOK/DKK) blocked many otherwise-strong pages from being verified in USD on a complete product page. No live d937 helicopter page with combined USD+rating+hero was captured. Did not force audio/self-guided/app tours, inactive products, thin-review SKUs, near-duplicates, or products with unusable heroes. Same completeness constraint documented on Cabo San Lucas (14), Puerto Vallarta (10), Cancun (13), and Mexico City (11).
